time.over: That took a bit longer than you guessed. No problem, time flies.
time.under: You finished sooner than you guessed.
time.note: You estimated {{est}}, and it took {{act}}. The difference was {{err}}.
time.question: How many seconds do you think it takes to quietly count from 1 to 10?
time.explain: The difference is the gap between your estimate and the actual time. It's only for tracking, not a health measure.
time.countNow: Count from 1 to 10 now, and press stop as soon as you finish.
time.pressStart: Press start, count from 1 to 10, then stop.
time.quiet: I'll stay quiet while you count...

calm.intro: Take it easy. Choose what suits you, and you can stop any time.
calm.breathGuide: Breathe in through your nose and out through your mouth.
calm.quietGuide: No guided breathing. Just take half a minute of quiet.
calm.done: You took it at your own pace.
calm.how: How would you like it today?
calm.tone: A soft tone with each breath
calm.disclaimer: A relaxation exercise, with no promised result. If it bothers you, stop it from the top.

start.intro: We'll start with just one small step.
start.notStarted: That's okay, you tried. We can come back to it when it suits you.
start.taskQ: What task have you been putting off?
start.taskPh: Write it in your own words
start.stepQ: What's the smallest first step? Just two minutes.
start.error: Write the task and the step so we can start.
start.privacy: What you type stays on your device and isn't sent anywhere. You can delete it in My Profile.
start.goDoIt: Go do it while the clock runs here. You can pause it from the top.
start.honest: The timer ending doesn't mean the task is done. Choose what really happened. Any answer is fine.

attention.note: You found {{found}} differences, with {{misses}} taps on something that stayed the same.

hints.left_top: Check the top left of the scene.

emotion.intro: Take your time. You can skip anything.
emotion.said: You told me: {{feelings}}. Thanks for sharing.
emotion.note: These are your words, and they stay on your device. If things feel heavy, talk to someone you trust or a professional.
emotion.feelQ: How do you feel right now?
emotion.feelNote: You can choose more than one. I don't guess. This is your answer.
emotion.privacy: Your answers stay on your device, aren't sent to the AI service, and earn no points.
